title: cardamomum speciosum
intro: Cardamomum speciosum, commonly known as black cardamom or brown cardamom, is a type of plant that belongs to the ginger family (Zingiberaceae). It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat a variety of health issues, including indigestion, nausea, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of black cardamom include its carminative and expectorant properties, which help to relieve digestive discomfort and ease respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of black cardamom include volatile oils, particularly limonene, beta-pinene, and 1,8-cineole, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
